title: 2024 law protecting ICIG whistleblowers who disclose CIA and DOE secrets

tellings.quote: whistleblowers going to the ICIG, uh, if they disclose CIA secrets and Department of Energy secrets, they're not allowed to be prosecuted for espionage."

plain: A 2024 law passed by the US Congress is said to protect whistleblowers who go to the inspector general of the intelligence community, a watchdog office over US spy agencies, so they cannot be prosecuted for espionage if they reveal secrets of the CIA or the Department of Energy. A whistleblower named Dylan Borland describes the law without naming a source, saying such people "are not allowed to be prosecuted for espionage." If true, it would make it safer for insiders to speak about hidden programmes.
